# Federal Register of Legislation fixture

`census-amendment-ordinance-1981-p1.pdf` is page 1 of the Register's PDF of the *Census and Statistics
(Amendment) Ordinance 1981* (Territory of Christmas Island), title F2006B00784, compilation start 1981-06-09,
extracted unchanged with `pdfseparate -f 1 -l 1`. The page is one 3310x4680 CCITT scan; the only text layer
is the Register's footer stamp "Federal Register of Legislative Instruments F2006B00784".

Source: https://api.prod.legislation.gov.au/v1/documents(titleid='F2006B00784',start=1981-06-09T00:00:00,retrospectivestart=1981-06-09T00:00:00,rectificationversionnumber=0,type='Primary',uniqueTypeNumber=0,volumeNumber=0,format='Pdf')
Downloaded 2026-11-13; the three-page source file's SHA-256 is 681fac34d7d34de374a749565d9cf0621c99fbcac2026645d95a888040c20e5e
(this page's is 0bc7ef402c8ec7593e72f30e5ec60dc037c616c32264ae402abf35ed9f6dc4e2).
